explanation: In classical genetics, each trait in a pea plant is controlled by two alleles, which are alternate forms of a gene. A dominant allele, represented by a capital letter, masks the expression of a recessive allele, represented by a lower-case letter. Alleles are located at a particular gene locus on a homologous pair of chromosomes. An individual is homozygous if they have identical alleles at a locus, and heterozygous if they have different alleles.

questions.q: What is the difference between homozygous and heterozygous genotypes?
opts: Homozygous means having different alleles; heterozygous means having identical alleles.
Homozygous means having alleles on different chromosomes; heterozygous means having them on homologous chromosomes.
Homozygous means having identical alleles at a gene locus; heterozygous means having different alleles at a gene locus.
Homozygous refers to sex chromosomes; heterozygous refers to autosomes.
